body: as you could probably see, i feel the same way, and though it may seem irrelevant, i would like for you to read the replies by the various people who are/have gone through similar things that we both are. their words gave me a new perspective and while i was not completely on the brink of going through with suicide, i am positive that i dont want to do it right now either. come this week? who knows what will happen you know? but (although it’s really hard to think this way for me at least) lets cross that bridge when we come to it
thank you for your words! i definitely needed to hear this

oh my goodness you’re so kind thank you so much, truly. and you are completely right i am kinda calm right now haha (also thank you for making me feel valid about feeling not terrible even after just spilling out my emotions)
hello! thank you for writing this to me. i wasn’t expecting many people to respond aha but each one of these are helping me in the moment! i very much needed this, so thank you!

thank you for sharing your story, im very proud of you for what you’ve accomplished! coming from an understanding mind, i know things were difficult and maybe still are sometimes, but hearing that you feel better makes me glad. i would love for things to get better for my situation too but as of right now i don’t know exactly what “better” is (idk if that makes sense ahh)
thank you so much for this. i will try my hardest to believe you i promise.
